line.s_stand.text: I opened a lemonade stand! Look, a queue has formed.

line.s_biggest.text: I will serve the bunny first. It is the biggest!

line.s_not_biggest.text: In a queue it does not matter who is the biggest! What matters is who stands first.

line.s_order.text: The one standing nearest the stand. Then the second, the third, and so on.

line.s_what.text: First, second, third? Will you show me?

line.s_show.text: We count from the stand. Look at the numbers.

line.s_point_first.text: Point to the one standing first.

line.wrong_place.text: That is not the place. Count from the stand.

line.wrong_place.lisek.text: That is not the place. Count from the stand.

line.s_point_last.text: And who stands last, at the very end?

line.s_point_third.text: Point to the one standing third.

line.s_serve.text: Here you are, lemonade for the first one!

line.s_first_now.text: The hedgehog left and everyone moved up. Who is first now?

line.s_solved.text: Now I understand! I serve them in order, from the first.

line.s_to_playground.text: Let's go to the playground. There is a queue there too.

line.b_slide.text: Everyone wants to go down the slide. The slide is on the left.

line.b_point_second.text: Point to the one standing second.

line.b_done.text: The mouse is last! It waits nicely for its turn.

line.b_to_home.text: Let's go home. There will be cookies!

line.c_cookies.text: Five guests are queuing for cookies. We count from the front of the queue, on the left.

line.c_point_fifth.text: Point to the one standing fifth.

line.c_between.text: Who stands between the second and the fourth?

line.c_solved.text: The third! Now you know the places in a queue.

line.p_intro.text: Let's play queues! We always count from the front of the queue, on the left.

line.p_first.text: Point to the one standing first.

line.p_second.text: Point to the one standing second.

line.p_third.text: Point to the one standing third.

line.p_fourth.text: Point to the one standing fourth.

line.p_last.text: Point to the one standing last.

line.a_game.text: Let's play a queue of toys. They stand in a row.

line.a_ok.text: All right! We count from the arrow.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to line up toys in a queue with you. Which one is first, and which one is last?

line.b_first_now.text: Everyone moved up. Who is first now?

line.wrong_place_q.text: That is not the place. Count from the front of the queue.

line.wrong_place_q.lisek.text: That is not the place. Count from the front of the queue.

line.wrong_place_arrow.text: That is not the place. Count from the arrow.

line.wrong_place_arrow.lisek.text: That is not the place. Count from the arrow.

line.b_mouse_goes.text: The mouse is first, so it goes down first!

line.b_mouse_again.text: It wants another go, so it goes to the end of the queue.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for our adventure together! Here's a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the little hedgehog from Fox. We got it when we learned who is first and who is last in a queue.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you soon!
